problem_title: SOQL vs SOSL - Which one to use and when?
caption:
SOQL vs SOSL - Which one to use and when?

🔴 The Problem: What arguments can be made to use SOQL or SOSL? When would you use one over the other? What is the main difference?

✅ The Fix: Let's make a quick comparison of the two: Definition SOQL (Salesforce Object Query Language) Use the Salesforce Object Query Language (SOQL) to construct simple but powerful query strings in the queryString parameter in the query() call, in Apex statements, in Visualforce controllers and getter methods, or in the Schema Explorer of the Force.com IDE.
